nodes.text: Start tomorrow morning small, practice a week, then scale to big decisions.

evidence.text: Tomorrow morning: before checking the phone, decide specifically what the first hour should deliver (calm, energy, connection, solitude), then pursue it; notice how unlike grabbing scrolling this feels.

Practice a week on small things (breakfast, evenings, weekends), noting satisfaction versus time-filling; then scale up: decide desired work before postings, desired relationship before swiping, problem before products.

The muscle enables larger intentions, intentions become values, values make a proposer. Proposers end better in matching math and messy life alike, not from specialness but from the equation's other side.

nodes.text: Entertainment drill: three weeks of naming, seeking, and protecting intention with timers.

evidence.text: Appendix entertainment: Week 1 name the intended feeling and log intention-to-delivery; Week 2 search specific content by intention; Week 3 set a timer, challenge autoplay against the intention, close when fulfilled.

nodes.text: Shopping drill: exact problem, 3-5 must-haves, 24-hour rule over $100.

evidence.text: Appendix shopping: define the exact problem, list 3-5 must-haves, research those features (not best-of-2025 lists), ignore store layout, apply the 24-hour rule over $100. Toothpaste drill: need, ingredient, buy, compare the feeling.

nodes.text: Jobs drill: two-week energy map, five non-negotiables, apply only at 4-of-5 matches.

evidence.text: Appendix jobs: quarterly energy mapping over two weeks, pattern finding, five non-negotiables, researching companies without postings, intentional outreach; if applying, match at least 4 of 5 criteria and track proposer versus receiver applications.

nodes.text: Relationships drill: specific intention plus 3-5 must-align values, seek and filter.

evidence.text: Appendix relationships: write the specific relationship intention and 3-5 must-align values, seek demonstrators, filter first dates on values; friendships: name the need, go where those people are, invite specifically.

Appendix micro-practices: 5-minute morning (three specific intentions before the phone), 5-minute evening review (proposer or receiver today), 10-second pause practice (intentional or merely selecting) building awareness first.

nodes.text: Three-column journal for 30 days: situation, mode, outcome; start small.

evidence.text: Appendix tracking: a three-column journal (situation, mode, outcome) for 30 days; proposer entries will show higher satisfaction. Intention is asking what one wants before others answer; start small and the capacity grows.
